execution.energy_measurement_note: NVML energy/power readings cover the whole GPU while sibling runs may be active; do not sum per-run values.
execution.telemetry_scope: per-process CPU plus whole-device GPU/system aggregates; other training workers may overlap
execution.training_wall_time_note: The launcher may overlap this run with sibling GPU work; compare wall time only with the same concurrency policy.

architecture_contract.calibrated_gate_bias: trainable alpha bias fitted from training batches; calibration is a package treatment
architecture_contract.decay_parameterization: sigmoid(alpha projection); scalar, grouped, or channel-wise
architecture_contract.default_gate_bias: no alpha bias; sigmoid(0)=0.5 before input effects
architecture_contract.embedding_output: tied token embedding and output projection
architecture_contract.normalization: pre-attention RMSNorm and pre-MLP RMSNorm; final RMSNorm
architecture_contract.reference_scope: simplified common-backbone ablation; not a full production KDA/GDN reproduction
architecture_contract.write_parameterization: sigmoid(beta projection), one value per head

capacity_comparison.gate_parameter_overhead_definition: trainable alpha/beta/gate projection storage included in parameter_components.gates

training_energy.reason: NVML exposes neither a total-energy counter nor GPU power samples

energy.reason: Energy capture disabled for this resource measurement

training_resources.memory_measurement_scope: per-context peak; allocated and reserved CUDA allocator values

other_gpu_activity.interpretation: NVML-visible compute processes only; zero does not prove the GPU was otherwise idle
